Read entire cumulative four-file diff and all relevant production/tests at pinned HEAD; verify code sources, not implementer claims alone
Strictness, frozen/extra-forbid DTOs and constants, cross-field/hash/binding invariants and scientific profiles

output_branch_policy: Own authorized claude/ branch, preferably claude/020-a-checkpoint1-review; preserve other branches, main and existing documents
required_report: BLOCKERS/MAJORS/MINORS/NOTES with normative and file/line evidence, without exposing sensitive data
Conformity and regressions within CP1; no speculative future requirements
Collected count reconciliation and tests actually executed versus supplied
Z limitation disposition without altering contract
Verdict APPROVE / APPROVE WITH NOTES / REQUEST CHANGES; READY FOR CHECKPOINT 2 REVIEW GATE YES/NO (not implementation authorization)
Output path/lines/bytes/SHA-256, published commit/ref; code repository modified NO
prohibited: Editing implementer report or architect central STATUS/tasks
Reopening closed documentary choices by preference
Amending frozen SVG grammar or including Z
PR, merge, formal GitHub approval, comments, force push, amend/reset/rebase, configuration/visibility changes
next_gate: Receive original full review and evidence, verify bytes/full SHA-256, preserve originals and reconcile all findings before releasing corrective task; do not repeat completed review solely because push failed
